features.aiInterviewerDesc: Practice with our advanced AI that adapts to your responses and provides realistic interview scenarios.

howItWorks.title: How Interview Coach Works
howItWorks.aiStep1Desc: Select your target job, industry, and level. The AI adapts everything to you.
howItWorks.aiStep2Desc: Answer realistic questions in real-time. The AI responds like a real interviewer.
howItWorks.aiStep3Desc: See your score, confidence level, ideal answer, and what to improve after each question.
howItWorks.aiStep4Desc: Track scores over time and keep practising until you feel completely ready.
howItWorks.coachStep1Desc: Filter by industry, experience level, price, and rating. Read reviews from past candidates.
howItWorks.coachStep2Desc: Choose a date, time, and session length that works for you. Pay securely online.
howItWorks.coachStep3Desc: Join a video call with your expert coach. Practice interview scenarios in real time.
howItWorks.coachStep4Desc: Receive a personalised report with actionable next steps and improvement areas.
